definitions.gloss: consignee; recipient of goods; addressee (of a shipment)
definitions.explanation: The person or entity designated to receive shipped goods or cargo. A standard term in logistics, shipping, and trade documentation.

examples.japanese: {荷受人|にうけにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check the name of the consignee.

examples.japanese: {荷受人|にうけにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧。
examples.english: The package was taken back because the recipient was not present.

examples.japanese: ⟦{送|おく}り{状|じょう}→送り状：20280_okurijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荷送人|にだしにん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{荷受人|にうけにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write both the sender's and the consignee's addresses on the shipping document.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧ (cargo, goods), {受|うけ} (receive), and ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). A term from logistics and shipping used on delivery slips, invoices, and trade documents. While ⟦{受取人|うけとりにん}→受取人：19162_uketorinin⟧ is more common in everyday contexts, {荷受人|にうけにん} is the standard term in commercial shipping and freight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷受人|にうけにん}⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: consignee's address
- {荷受人|にうけにん}⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧: consignee absent
- {荷受人|にうけにん}{払|ばら}い: freight collect (consignee pays)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受取人|うけとりにん}→受取人：19162_uketorinin⟧: recipient — more general; used for packages, letters, and money
- {届|とど}け{先|さき}: delivery destination — refers to the address rather than the person
- {荷送人|にだしにん}: shipper/consignor — the person who sends the goods (the counterpart)
